convention_adopted.rule: frozen artifacts are named with version and content hash, e.g. frozen_formula_spec_v2_45edc424.json; they are NEVER replaced in place; each version records its predecessor's sha256
convention_adopted.scope: all future frozen plans, specifications and baselines in this investigation

pattern.statement: Three instances of one failure mode: an identifier that does not uniquely denote its content.
instances: duplicate fixture basenames carrying different hashes (FrozenSMOPF matched_success_* exists in two directories, +91 bytes apart; only the path disambiguates)
a frozen plan carrying the fixture-specific constant 9166 as if it were general (valid for W; wrong for X 9168 and Y 2934)
a frozen, approved specification replaced in place (this defect)
pattern.remedy: version-and-hash naming; operational rather than literal constants in frozen plans; path-qualified fixture identity
